headline_interactive: EggMarketExplorer (native SVG IIFE, #em-svg). Marshallian cross locked to the chapter calibration Qd=200-5p, Qs=c+10p with a draggable supply-intercept slider c in [10,60] + 3 presets (pre-HPAI c=50 / post-shock c=20 / partial-recovery c=35). Plots inverse demand (blue) and inverse supply (red), the green equilibrium dot, shaded CS triangle (blue) and PS region (red), and live readouts of (Q*, p*), CS, PS, total surplus, and dCS vs the pre-shock baseline. Browser-verified exact: c=50 -> (150, $10.00) / CS $2,250M / PS $1,125M / dCS 0; c=20 -> (140, $12.00) / CS $1,960M / PS $980M / dCS -$290M; c=35 -> (145, $11.00) / CS $2,102.5M / PS $1,051.25M / dCS -$147.5M. Directly fuses W2.1 (equilibrium), W2.2 (supply shock), W2.4 (surplus triangles), and W2.7 (recovery comparative statics) into one widget — equilibrium, welfare, and comparative statics are one machine.
